title: Fix no results for the hit widget

comments.body:
Can you ammend commit first line to follow conventional changelog? (https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)

``` text
feat(hits): pass the full results to the noResultsTemplate
```

You'll get used to it :)

> Good ?

better with full sentence ;) "no results" isn't very explicit
